scope: P2-G2 ASSEMBLY preparation; synthetic/local real PostgreSQL tests; no live acceptance or Gate approval.
measurement_method: Measured enums and counts come only from matching source-case JSON diagnostics in SHA-bound passing TAP blocks; expected outputs and source assertions do not substitute for measurements.
One natural source scenario is one denominator unit. Mechanism and other cases do not count toward recognition metrics.
Single-Reporter multi-turn classification uses the last chronological logged decision. Multi-Reporter and mixed human-context scenarios are excluded from single-enum confusion matrices.
Singleton expectations contribute recall and confusion. Set-valued expectations contribute separate set admissibility. Original-label agreement remains separate from adjudicated metrics.

Review and automatic Ticket rates count scenarios with positive logged normal-pipeline database increments or complete scenario counts; duplicate proofs are not summed. A Ticket action alone may reuse an existing Ticket and does not prove creation.
Ticket creation and Review enqueue may coexist. Missing count diagnostics remain unknown; complete 122-case rates are not claimed.

original_reference_label_agreement.meaning: Frozen-label agreement, not independently adjudicated recognition accuracy.

adjudicated_singleton_classification.meaning: Recall against independently adjudicated singleton expectations on measured comparable subset.

adjudicated_set_admissibility.meaning: Membership in pre-adjudicated acceptable sets, not singleton accuracy.

manual_review_case_rate.exclusion_reason: Complete scenario Ticket and Review counts absent from current TAP diagnostics; missing is unknown, not zero.

automatic_ticket_creation_case_rate.exclusion_reason: Complete scenario Ticket and Review counts absent from current TAP diagnostics; missing is unknown, not zero.

limitations: Regression corpus is not random or held out; no population or production accuracy claim.
Original semantics are not universally passed. D005 and D023 retain source-audit limitations.
All source-audit timing, directory simulator, channel declaration and semantic adjudication limits continue to apply.
Measured-subset rates never impute missing cases; no full-122 classification accuracy is asserted.
refresh_method: Every measured result/count proof revalidated against the matching current passing diagnostic; unchanged source labels, formulas and denominators.
